newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico overnight Cetes rate falls 300 bp to 29 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico overnight Cetes rate falls 300 bp to 29 pct.

text.p: Mexico's overnight Cetes rate plunged 300 basis points to 26.0 percent at midsession on increased liquidity and peso stability, traders said.
"The morning's high was 28.40 percent, which itself was exaggerated, especially as the peso is very stable," said a trader.
The benchmark 48-hour peso was meanwhile trading 0.1 of a centavo firmer at 7.7120/7.7220 per dollar, after weakening 1.5 centavos to 7.7300/7.7380 in early trade.
Other traders said that Banco de Mexico's substantial injection of 5.532 billion pesos also helped to increase liquidity in the overnight market.
Overnight rates on bank paper were meanwhile 20 basis points down at 29.75 percent.
